notes: παρεστῶτες carries no dative object here, so by answers to no other source token and rides inside the participle's unit under rule 106's preverb arm — the contrast with 23:2 and 23:11, where a dative stands.

τὸν ἀρχιερέα τοῦ θεοῦ → God's high priest: the ASV writes the possessor prenominally with no determiner of its own, so the outer article is emptied under rule 20 and the inner one under rule 23 (rule 57).
